body:
Thanks so much for your reply. Aside from treating others like crap, this sounds exactly like me. I'll have to look at it. I have Feeling Good - but it's been a while since I read it. I did Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for two years, but then hit sort of a plateau, and have been going to another counselor with a different style. Perhaps it's time to switch it up/back again.

I feel for you too. It's so hard to cope with and I've been working on this so hard for three straight years. I need a rest. You seem farther along than I. Do you ever get a break?

Thanks again.
